Since $\overset{―}{kv}=\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v},$ we get the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{kv} & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v} \\ [\begin{aligned}-6+8\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}-2\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}]} \\ [\begin{aligned}-6+8\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{-2\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{0}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-6+8\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}2\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-6+8\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2\text{i}\,\overset{―}{k} \\ 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we obtain that 

$$
2\text{i}\,\overset{―}{k}=-6+8\text{i}\,⟹\,\overset{―}{k}=\frac{-6+8\text{i}}{2\text{i}}=4+3\text{i}.
$$

 

Therefore, $k=\overset{―}{4+3\text{i}}=4-3\text{i}.$

Finally, $\text{Im}(k)=-3.$
